EmblemHealth's summer 2027 analytics internships are open now and close on **November 1, 2026** . On October 5, 2026 its[careers site](https://careers.emblemhealth.com/jobs/search) listed **three remote Healthcare Data Analytics internships (Actuarial, Healthcare Economics and Underwriting)** , each paying **$30 an hour** for a 10-week program from June 7 to August 13, 2027. In plain words: you apply during fall 2026, you intern in summer 2027.


That deadline is a month earlier than last year's December 1, so don't plan around the old date. EmblemHealth also runs a separate **Summer Associate Program** for strategy, product, markets and medical management. It isn't posted yet: last year it opened on November 3, 2025 and closed at 5 PM Eastern on January 16, 2026, so expect the summer 2027 version from early November 2026 with a deadline around mid-January 2027.

## What Is an EmblemHealth Internship?


An EmblemHealth internship is a paid, 10-week summer role at EmblemHealth, a New York not-for-profit health insurer formed from Group Health Incorporated (GHI) and the Health Insurance Plan of Greater New York (HIP). It runs two student programs: remote Healthcare Data Analytics internships in actuarial, healthcare economics and underwriting, and a hybrid Summer Associate Program where students work cross-functionally with senior leaders. EmblemHealth's[Our Story page](https://www.emblemhealth.com/about/our-story) traces its roots to the 1930s, and the company owns AdvantageCare Physicians and runs more than a dozen EmblemHealth Neighborhood Care locations across New York.


## When Do EmblemHealth Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


EmblemHealth runs two calendars. The Healthcare Data Analytics internships posted August 20 and 21, 2026 with a stated window of August 19 to November 1, about 9.5 months before the June 7, 2027 start. Last year's version ran August 7 to December 1, 2025, so the close moved a month earlier and the window shrank from about 16 weeks to about 10. The Summer Associate Program ran November 3, 2025 to January 16, 2026, with on-site interviews in mid-February, for a June 1 start. Expect the summer 2027 version on a similar schedule, though one prior cycle is the only evidence.

The company's official careers page is always the most current source. If a role is posted there, go by that, even if this page suggests the window hasn't opened yet.*


### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


EmblemHealth uses hard deadlines, not rolling admissions. Each analytics posting states its window, August 19 to November 1, 2026, and the 2026 Summer Associate postings said all applications had to be in by 5 PM Eastern on January 16. There's no late entry after those dates. The other risk is relying on last year's calendar: the analytics deadline moved from December 1 to November 1, so a student who remembers December would miss it. Apply to the analytics internships in October, and have your Summer Associate application ready before the expected early-November opening.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Requirements differ by program; the work authorization rule applies to both:


• **Analytics majors:** a bachelor's degree in progress in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, computer science, a physical science, health care or a related finance or business field, depending on the role.


• **Analytics class year:** current third-year undergraduates are preferred on all three postings; the actuarial role prefers at least one actuarial exam.


• **Summer Associate (2026 rules):** a 3.0 GPA or higher preferred, interest in health care, and graduation between December 2026 and May 2028 for undergraduates or December 2026 and June 2027 for graduate students. Expect those windows to move forward a year for 2027.


• **Work authorization:** EmblemHealth says it can't consider applicants who need visa sponsorship before or after hire, including H-1B, F-1 STEM OPT and TN, apart from extremely rare exceptions.


• **Schedule:** full-time, 40 hours a week for 10 weeks.


### Is the 3.0 GPA a Hard Cutoff at EmblemHealth?


No. The 2026 Summer Associate postings said a 3.0 or above is preferred, not required, and the analytics internships name no GPA at all. Their stronger filters are major and year: third-year students in quantitative majors are preferred, and an actuarial exam helps for the actuarial role. The sponsorship rule is firmer than the GPA line and appears on every posting.


## What Skills Does EmblemHealth Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


EmblemHealth's analytics postings share a quantitative core: strong mathematical and analytical skills, Excel and Microsoft Office, and written and verbal communication to explain complex information. The Healthcare Economics role adds health care data plus Tableau or Power BI and exposure to SQL, SAS or Python, and the Actuarial role adds actuarial principles and an exam. The 2026 Summer Associate postings asked for something broader: analytical, collaborative, communication and project management skills, plus a genuine interest in health care.

## What Is the EmblemHealth Application and Interview Process Like?


EmblemHealth publishes program details in each posting but not a full interview guide:


1. **Apply per posting.** Each analytics role and each Summer Associate track has its own posting on the careers site.


2. **Meet the deadline.** Analytics postings close November 1, 2026; Summer Associate postings closed at 5 PM Eastern on a stated January date last year.


3. **Interviews.** The 2026 Summer Associate Program held on-site interviews in mid-February; EmblemHealth doesn't describe the analytics interview format.


4. **Offer.** Offers come by email from HRTalentAcquisition with the subject Offer of Employment for your job title; EmblemHealth says it never asks you to pay to apply or to join a Google Hangout.


5. **Start.** Analytics interns start June 7, 2027, full-time and remote.


Prepare short project stories with results; our[behavioral interview guide](https://www.extern.com/post/behavioral-interview-questions-star-method-guide) shows how to structure them.

## How Do You Stand Out for an EmblemHealth Internship?


Three moves. **First, beat the earlier deadline.** The analytics internships close November 1, a month earlier than last year, so submit in October. **Second, show the quantitative basics with proof.** The postings want strong math, Excel and the ability to explain complex numbers; an actuarial exam, a pricing model or a Tableau dashboard you built makes that concrete. **Third, pick your Summer Associate track early.** Last year's seven tracks ranged from strategy to medical management, and you applied to one, so decide where your interest in health care fits before the November posting. EmblemHealth doesn't publish class size, applicant numbers or a conversion rate.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 EmblemHealth internship?


No. Summer 2026 has already run, and its postings show as closed. The open door is summer 2027: three remote Healthcare Data Analytics internships at $30 an hour, open until November 1, 2026. The Summer Associate Program for summer 2027 is expected to post in early November 2026.


### When is the EmblemHealth summer 2027 internship deadline?


For the Actuarial, Healthcare Economics and Underwriting internships, November 1, 2026, as stated in each posting. That's a month earlier than last year's December 1. The Summer Associate Program isn't posted yet; last year it closed at 5 PM Eastern on January 16, so expect mid-January 2027.


### How much do EmblemHealth interns make?


$30 an hour. All three summer 2027 analytics postings list it, and the 2026 Summer Associate postings paid the same. At 40 hours a week for 10 weeks, that's about $12,000 before tax, our arithmetic from EmblemHealth's published rate. The programs are full-time and paid.


### Are EmblemHealth internships remote?


The three Healthcare Data Analytics internships are remote, listed under New York, New York. The Summer Associate Program was hybrid in 2026: associates were told they might be asked to come to the New York office two days a week. Check the 2027 Summer Associate postings for this year's arrangement.


### Who should apply to EmblemHealth's analytics internships?


Bachelor's students in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, computer science or related fields, with current third-years preferred. The Actuarial role prefers at least one actuarial exam, and the Healthcare Economics role prefers health care data experience, Tableau or Power BI, and exposure to SQL, SAS or Python.


### Does EmblemHealth sponsor visas for interns?


No. Every posting says EmblemHealth can't consider applicants who need visa sponsorship before or after hire, including H-1B, F-1 STEM OPT and TN, with only extremely rare exceptions. International students on F-1 status should plan on these internships being closed to them.


### What is the EmblemHealth Summer Associate Program?


A paid, 10-week program where students work cross-functionally with senior leaders on group projects. In 2026 it had seven tracks, from Strategy and Innovation to Medical Management and Neighborhood Care, paid $30 an hour, preferred a 3.0 GPA and held on-site interviews in mid-February. The 2027 postings are expected in early November.


### Does EmblemHealth have nursing or pharmacy internships?


None were found for 2026 or 2027. The Summer Associate Program's Clinical Strategy and Innovation and Medical Management tracks are business roles in clinical departments that welcome any major interested in health care. The last student pharmacy role found was a 2021 virtual Summer Associate track.


EmblemHealth's analytics internships close November 1, 2026, and the Summer Associate Program is expected to open right after. Apply this month, and build a project in parallel: a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) gives you finished work to discuss in interviews.
